rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for securing an object in place when the fastening method is not the focus.

example.english: Help me fasten this table in place so it does not move.
example.traditional: 你幫我固定好張枱，唔好畀佢郁。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 gu3 ding6 hou2 zoeng1 toi4 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 juk1

rows.note: Choose this when fastening something by tying it, especially with rope, string, or a cord.

example.english: Fasten the ropes properly, then the tent will be secure.
example.traditional: 你將啲繩綁好，個棚先至穩陣。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 di1 sing4 bong2 hou2 go3 paang4 sin1 zi3 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Choose this for fastening a button, buckle, belt, clip, or similar item by closing its fastening mechanism.

example.english: Remember to fasten your seat belt before leaving.
example.traditional: 出門口前記住扣好安全帶。
example.jyutping: ceot1 mun4 hau2 cin4 gei3 zyu6 kau3 hou2 on1 cyun4 daai2

rows.note: Choose this when fastening something securely by sticking or adhering it to a surface.

example.english: Use double-sided tape to fasten the poster securely to the wall.
example.traditional: 用雙面膠紙將張海報黐實喺牆上。
example.jyutping: jung6 soeng1 min6 gaau1 zi2 zoeng1 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 ci1 sat6 hai2 coeng4 soeng6
